mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 0.5% month-over-month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) over a 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% signals weakening labor market conditions, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between UNRATE changes and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between RSAFS changes and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the correlation between INDPRO changes and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05) over a 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.3% month-over-month, the combination signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the joint effect of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL on SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between PAYEMS changes and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or if the correlation between HOUST changes and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05) over a 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: When the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average and the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 3%, the combination signals a favorable supply-side environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with strong supply-side
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the joint effect of INDPRO and FEDFUNDS on SPX returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05) over a 3-year period.
